request.description: launch: start the Simulator and run gamePath in it. attach: debug the game an open Simulator already runs.

language.description: lua: the Simulator's own debug service. c: LLDB's lldb-dap (xcrun lldb-dap on macOS, lldb-dap on PATH elsewhere).

gamePath.description: The .pdx to run; required for launch.

sourcePath.description: Lua only. Directory the .pdx was compiled from. Defaults to <worktree>/Source. When pdc compiled a copy, point this at the original; otherwise breakpoints are accepted but never hit.

sdkPath.description: Playdate SDK root. Defaults to PLAYDATE_SDK_PATH from the shell environment.

simulatorPath.description: Simulator executable to use instead of the SDK's.
